name: Low Resistance Capillary Malformation
aliases: Capillary Malformation with Low Vascular Resistance

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Low Resistance Capillary Malformation Diagnostic Criteria

criteria.description: Presence of a flat, pink to red capillary malformation with blanching on pressure
Doppler ultrasound demonstrating low resistance blood flow within the malformation
No evidence of associated venous or lymphatic malformations on imaging
Lesion present at birth or early infancy

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of characteristic capillary malformation with blanching and confirmation of low resistance flow on Doppler ultrasound
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis relies heavily on clinical examination and vascular imaging; genetic testing is not currently diagnostic.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Flat pink to red capillary malformation with blanching
searchTerms: capillary malformation with pale on pressure

pathognomonic.symptomName: Low resistance blood flow within capillary malformation on Doppler ultrasound
searchTerms: low resistance blood flow in skin lesion
slow blood flow in capillary malformation
Doppler showing low resistance in lesion

common.symptomName: Localized skin discoloration with sharp borders
searchTerms: localized skin color change with clear edges

common.symptomName: Lesion present at birth or early infancy

searchTerms: mild increased temperature at lesion site

occasional.symptomName: Mild localized swelling adjacent to malformation

searchTerms: small dilated blood vessels around lesion
visible tiny blood vessels surrounding lesion

occasional.symptomName: Intermittent mild pain or tenderness over lesion

rare.symptomName: Development of localized hypertrophy beneath lesion

imaging: Doppler ultrasound showing low resistance blood flow within capillary malformation
MRI to exclude associated venous or lymphatic malformations
other: Clinical observation of blanching capillary malformation present at birth

distinguishingFeatures: Typically high resistance flow or absent flow on Doppler
May be associated with Sturge-Weber syndrome
Compressible lesion with slow flow on Doppler
Often blue or purple in color
